note: Sources, hashes, counts and licenses only. No model weights or dataset text are committed; local copies live outside Git.

checkpoint.architecture: BertForPreTraining (bert-base-uncased configuration): 12 layers, hidden 768, 12 heads, ~110M parameters (109.5M encoder)
checkpoint.tokenizer: BertTokenizer (uncased WordPiece, vocab 30,522), the LEGAL-BERT (nlpaueb/legal-bert-base-uncased) tokenizer
checkpoint.pretraining: LEGAL-BERT-SC re-trained 300K steps (MLM + NSP) on ~5.4M Indian court documents (Supreme Court and High Courts, 1950-2019, ~27 GB)
checkpoint.citation: Paul, Mandal, Goyal, Ghosh. Pre-trained Language Models for the Legal Domain: A Case Study on Indian Law. ICAIL 2023. arXiv:2209.06049

mps_check.forward: batch 8 x 512 tokens: last_hidden_state (8, 512, 768) float32, all finite; 262 ms per batch; 430 MiB MPS allocated; peak RSS 0.61 GiB
mps_check.fill_mask: 'The accused was convicted of [MASK] under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code.' -> offence, offences, charge, rape, murder
mps_check.tokenizer_note: 'BNS' tokenizes as b ##n ##s: the vocabulary predates the 2023 codes

datasets.name: InLegalNER (OpenNyAI legal NER)
datasets.access: gated (auto): terms accepted by the project owner; token read from .env, never printed or committed

mapping_to_legalai_ner_schema_v1.ORG: ORGANIZATION (their ORG includes police stations: POLICE_STATION partly)

datasets.training_allowed: yes under MIT, once access is granted
datasets.redistribution: allowed under MIT; we do not redistribute
datasets.license_verified: MIT (dataset card front matter at that revision)
datasets.citation: Kalamkar et al. Named Entity Recognition in Indian court judgments. NLLP 2022 (kalamkar-etal-2022-named)
datasets.format: Label Studio JSON: id, data.text, annotations[0].result[].value {start, end, text, labels}; meta.source = Indian Kanoon URL

datasets.name: ILSI (Indian Legal Statute Identification, LeSICiN)
datasets.official_source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6053791 (Zenodo record by the authors, linked from https://github.com/Law-AI/LeSICiN)
datasets.status: DOWNLOADED to ~/legalai_datasets/ilsi_zenodo_6053791/ (outside the repository); all MD5s match the Zenodo record
datasets.schema: id, text (list of fact sentences), labels (e.g. 'Section 302 in The Indian Penal Code'): IPC only, 100 sections
datasets.mapping_to_legalai: label 'Section N in The Indian Penal Code' -> (IPC, N). No BNS, BNSS, CrPC or special Acts.
datasets.coverage_of_legalai_section_gold: 22 of 60 positive gold labels (all IPC); 12 of 15 distinct IPC gold sections (missing 361, 378, 408); 15 of 36 queries have at least one expressible positive, 7 have all; 17 of 20 catalog IPC entries
datasets.redistribution: allowed with attribution; we do not redistribute

datasets.name: IL-TUR (Exploration-Lab)
datasets.status: STOPPED: not downloaded (requires a login and manual approval; non-commercial share-alike).

datasets.name: Hanno-Labs/indian-ipc-statute-identification
datasets.task: statute identification (facts -> one IPC section per row)
datasets.status: NOT DOWNLOADED: secondary candidate. 40,001 rows, ~14,900 cases, 320 IPC sections; source judgments not named, citations masked by the publisher. Provenance and leakage would need checking first.

datasets.name: AjayMukundS/Indian_Legal_NER_Dataset

leakage_check.ilsi_vs_gold: 0 shingle overlaps; 0 of 72 gold texts (36 NER, 36 section queries) appear verbatim in any ILSI case
leakage_check.rule: exclude every public instance whose Indian Kanoon ID is a corpus document or that shares a 13-word shingle with the corpus or gold texts

timing_probe.method: forward passes only on synthetic token IDs (a training step was blocked by the ml-pipeline hook); training step estimated as 3 x forward
timing_probe.machine: Apple M5, 24 GiB unified memory, MPS
timing_probe.memory: forward: 1.01 GiB MPS driver allocation; weights + gradients + AdamW moments: 1.62 GiB (computed); activations for training not measured
